summary: Corrected audit of the lung atlas. Myelinating Schwann cell markers NFASC, NCMAP, MBP, PRX are confirmed as annotation markers, and nonmyelinating Schwann cell markers NGFR, SCN7A, CHD2, L1CAM, NCAM1 were incorrectly downgraded to context_only and should be included as annotation markers. Added missing Schwann cell markers from Extended Data Fig. 5: MLIP (mSchwann), SOX10, GRIK2, ITGB4 (nmSchwann); CADM is ambiguous. No formal neuroendocrine marker evidence was found in the text or figure captions. All non-target cell type candidates (fibroblasts, vascular, epithelial, immune etc.) are excluded from the target scope.

issues.description: Nonmyelinating Schwann cell genes NGFR, SCN7A, CHD2, L1CAM, NCAM1 were downgraded to context_only in the existing extraction, but the paper identifies/annotates the nmSchwann cluster with these genes and later calls them marker genes. They should be annotation_marker and included.
Schwann cell markers SOX10, MLIP, GRIK2 and ITGB4 were not present in the existing extraction but are explicitly listed in Extended Data Fig.5g/j as Schwann cell markers.
The candidate 'CXC3CR' is an apparent typo/OCR artifact for CX3CR1; normalized accordingly.
'CADM' in Extended Data Fig.5g is ambiguous (CADM1-CADM4 family member); kept unresolved, not included in final table.

Neuroendocrine cells appear in the airway epithelial UMAP (Fig.4a; Extended Data Fig.7a), but no explicit marker genes for neuroendocrine cells are given in the text or figure captions, so no formal neuroendocrine marker could be extracted.

The existing candidate list contained many formal markers of non-target cell types (IR-fibro, PB-fibro, chondrocytes, vascular cells, SMG epithelial cells, immune cells, smooth muscle). All were excluded because they are outside target_cell_scope.
